Hi Chloe —

Thanks — great to hear you're moving forward. Please find our preliminary quote attached (GF_quote_20260912.xlsx) and a zip of current sample photos. Summary below: 

- Kitting (per kit): $4.75 (pin + patch + pouch + pick & pack)
- Labeling (retailer + expo): $0.45 per kit
- Split shipment handling (two destinations): flat $180 per shipment
- Rework/quality hold (if 2%+ fails): $75/hr on-site
- Customs brokerage: $220 (standard) / $650 (priority same-day clearance)
- Lead times: Production 7 business days after PO + 5 business days for standard shipping; expedited air cuts to 48–72 hours on confirmed inventory

We can do insured air-ship for the first 300 kits if you want priority staging — additional cost estimated at $1,100. We note enamel pin production has a 10–12 day die turnaround if you need a new mold; current samples use the existing die.

Attachments: GF_quote_20260912.xlsx, sample_photos.zip

If you want, Antonio at RapidFreight can provide an insured air manifest and ETA into the venue — I can loop him in.

Best,
Sofia Ramos
Operations Manager | GoodForward Creative

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications and asks before we lock the PO: 

- Can you split the quote to show unit costs for first 300 kits and incremental cost for additional runs? We may stagger orders.
- Please provide a line showing insured air option at 300 units with declared value and carrier (we prefer FedEx or RapidFreight).
- How do you propose handling a partial backorder if a component (pin) is delayed? We need a plan to ship completed kits and ship replacement pin-only packets later (no re-kitting).
- Confirm packaging dims/weights for carrier quotes.

Mutual action plan: 
1) GoodForward submits revised quote with air manifest + carrier by 2026-09-15.
2) Redwood PO issued by 2026-09-17 (pending procurement approval).
3) Production start 2026-09-20 if PO confirmed; staging to expo warehouse by 2026-10-07.

Also: please loop in Antonio Ruiz at RapidFreight for the insured manifest/ETA — cc'ing him would be great.

Thanks,
Chloe
